title: Andersen Consulting Adds Collaborating Firm TechSparq
summary: Andersen Consulting broadens its technology and business transformation capabilities through a Collaboration Agreement with TechSparq.
body_markdown:
Andersen Consulting broadens its technology and business transformation capabilities through a Collaboration Agreement with TechSparq, a U.S.-based firm that combines strategy, commerce engineering, and AI with hands-on implementation.


TechSparq is a digital consulting firm providing strategy and advisory, commerce engineering, and AI and agentic commerce services to organizations across retail and consumer goods, luxury and fashion, and eCommerce and direct-to-consumer markets. Headquartered in Oregon, the firm combines strategic planning with hands-on delivery to help clients advance digital initiatives, customer experience, and operating models.


“We built our firm to close the gap between the people who develop the strategy and the people responsible for making it work,” said Dedrick Boyd, founder and CEO of TechSparq. “Our collaboration with Andersen Consulting gives us an opportunity to bring that execution-focused model to a broader range of organizations while combining our approach with additional technology and global capabilities.”


“The distinction between strategy and execution is becoming increasingly difficult to sustain as businesses undertake complex digital and AI-driven transformation,” said Mark L. Vorsatz, global chairman and CEO of Andersen. “TechSparq’s model brings those disciplines together, complementing our technology and business transformation capabilities with a practical approach to turning strategic priorities into delivered solutions.”
